scenarios.expected: Links open permitted records and each preference affects its documented channel/event group. Portal preferences expose only supported groups; disabled email, unavailable records, and timing/timezone limits are explained.
scenarios.actual: Nadia's bell read 9+ with 28 unread; opening marked the 25 displayed items read, Mark all read was offered for the 3 remaining and took unread to 0, and the control was absent once nothing was unread. A mention item linked to /contracts/33 and opened C-33; Show older grew the list to 50. Profile menu, Settings, Personal, Notifications reached the grid: five groups, Dates approaching In-app only, Knowledge items Email only, and a Briefing card with Approvals, Tasks, Dates, Obligations, and Intake. With Assigned to you Email off a mention still raised the bell item and no mail arrived in 3 s after the queue settled; Email on delivered You were mentioned naming Ravi Menon; In-app off left unread and the newest item unchanged with no mail; each saved choice survived a reload. On a fresh Legal Team Member account the initial choices matched the guide table, a Chicago timezone before 08:00 deferred the briefing, an Asia/Dubai timezone brought a 1 date on your contracts mail naming one of two same-date Key dates and a Your daily briefing is ready bell summary that opened Home, and a further round sent nothing.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author; not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.

Mail absence was observed for 3 seconds after each controlled event once the Mailpit queue had settled, paired with positive deliveries through the same worker; this bounds the lab, not an arbitrary relay.

Filing an attachment, the Administrator lead-time procedure, and Document Versions were not performed; their guides (DOC-017, DOC-021) are unpublished and both articles stay in review until they pass.
The morning rounds were queued by the reviewer rather than waiting for the hourly cron; the worker served them with its real clock and rules.
The Administrator lead-time procedure links to the unpublished reminders guide (DOC-021); the article stays in review until that target passes.
Knowledge-only briefings and Entity Obligation reminders were not produced in this lab.
